name: Healthcare (HL7 Interface & Queue Monitoring)
description: Pattern-compatible with HL7 v2.x/v3 interfaces, ADT admission queues, ORU lab result streams, pharmacy CPOE orders, and EDI 837 billing gateways.

assets.name: ADT Patient Inbound Feed
assets.description: Inbound hospital admission and transfer feed. Feeds bed management and real-time patient rosters.

assets.name: Lab Results Interface
assets.description: Critical laboratory diagnostics feed delivering stat pathology, CBC, and microbiological findings.

assets.name: Interface Event Queue
assets.description: Reliable transactional buffer holding pending HL7 segments, MSA acknowledgments, and retry buckets.

assets.name: Pharmacy CPOE Dispenser
assets.description: Computerized Provider Order Entry verifying contraindications and routing stat medication doses.

assets.name: Claims & Billing Extractor
assets.description: Translates clinical encounters and diagnostic codes (ICD-10/CPT) into standard insurance claims.

message_rejection_rate.name: HL7 Message Rejection Rate
message_rejection_rate.description: Monitors percentage of ERR/NACK message frames over 15-minute sliding window

queue_depth_and_age.name: Interface Queue Depth & Head Age
queue_depth_and_age.description: Alerts if interface queue holds > 50 messages or oldest pending message > 10 minutes

missing_acknowledgments.name: Missing MSA Acknowledgment Frames
missing_acknowledgments.description: Tracks unacknowledged MSA-AA frames waiting for receiver handshake

duplicate_message_rate.name: Duplicate HL7 Control ID Rate
duplicate_message_rate.description: Monitors duplicate MSH-10 message control IDs across the queue

adt_message_freshness.name: ADT Inbound Stream Freshness
adt_message_freshness.description: Ensures admission stream heartbeat is received within 5 minutes

pharmacy_dispenser_health.name: Pharmacy CPOE Dispenser Channel Health
pharmacy_dispenser_health.description: Verifies cpoe_order_dispenser worker process is active and free of deadlock exceptions.

cpoe_order_freshness.name: CPOE Stat Medication Routing Freshness
cpoe_order_freshness.description: Ensures stat prescription orders are routed within the 5-minute clinical SLA window.

claims_adapter_status.name: EDI 837 Claims Generator Health
claims_adapter_status.description: Verifies that the edi_837_generator claims batching service is running without parser faults.

billing_freshness_sla.name: CMS-1500 Encounter Ingestion Freshness
billing_freshness_sla.description: Verifies encounter data arrived within 30-minute reimbursement batching window.

CRITICAL.criteria: Direct patient care impact: lab diagnostics blocked or pharmacy order dispatch frozen > 15m.

HIGH.criteria: Interface queue backing up > 100 messages or duplicate control rate > 1%.

MEDIUM.criteria: Billing queue delay without immediate clinical care impact.
